function.name: ProductSearch_execute
function.description: Performs a search for products in the database based on specified criteria, such as keywords and filters, and returns a list of matching products. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

keywords.description: The search terms used to find products, separated by spaces.

category.description: The category to filter the search results. If no category is specified, all categories will be included in the search.

price_range.description: A price range to narrow down the search results, specified as a string in the format 'min-max' where min and max are prices in USD.

sort_order.description: The order in which the search results are sorted. Choose 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order.

in_stock.description: A flag to filter search results to only include products that are in stock. Set to true to include only in-stock items.

message.content: Hai! Sepertinya kamu menanyakan kapan ukuran 40 akan tersedia. Bisa kasih tahu produk atau kategori apa yang kamu cari? Dengan begitu saya bisa cek stok dan estimasi ketersediaannya. Terima kasih!
message.reasoning:
The user says: "Size 40 kapan ready kak". This seems like a request in Indonesian: "Size 40 kapan ready kak" meaning "When will size 40 be ready, buddy?" They might be asking about product availability. We need to respond appropriately. We can ask clarifying question: what product? Or we can interpret they want to know when size 40 will be ready. We can ask for product name or category. We can also provide a generic answer: "We don't have that info." But we can use the function to search for products with size 40? The function doesn't support size. Only keywords, category, price_range, sort_order, in_stock. We could search for "size 40" but that's not a product. We could ask for clarification.

Thus we should respond politely asking for more details: product name or category.
